name: EasyCache
plain: Skips whole model forwards when predicted output change is small, then adds the cached output−input difference to the current input. It estimates output change from the measured input change and the last-seen ratio of output change to input change. Needs no per-model calibration, unlike TeaCache.
math:
On first-cond model call, in the start/end window:
Δin = mean|x↓ − x_prev↓| (8× subsample of first cond's slice)
r̂ = R·Δin/‖y_prev‖₁, ‖·‖₁ = mean abs; C += r̂
If C < τ and every cond's diff exists: skip, y = x + diff_uuid for each cond. Other conds follow via skip_current_step.
Else C=0, run model. After a run: R = mean|y↓−y_prev↓|/Δin; diff_uuid = y − x.
LTX2 lists [video,audio] handled together; shape mismatch cuts from the start and logs nothing.

props.architectures: Model-agnostic at the DIFFUSION_MODEL wrapper; first output_channels (latent_channels) only. LTX2 AV lists supported.
